note: BH-8817: the most pages of 100 escalated ledger rows one read takes, in Tackler's card sweep (bin/unblock.sh) and in Archie's card lane (bin/archie-cards.sh). The next page is read only while a page is full and its oldest row is younger than UNBLOCK_CARD_TTL_H. A full last page logs `sweep truncated`. A bad value is the code fallback 5 and one log line.
